name: GreenPulse Header
format:
GreenPulse
Smart plant care, monitored live
IoT project dashboard --
Plant thought
Water gently, grow patiently.
About GreenPulse

GreenPulse is a smart, agentic IoT plant-care system. An ESP32 device reads soil moisture, temperature, humidity, light and air quality, and sends the data securely over MQTT (TLS) to AWS IoT Core.

A cloud LLM backend combines those readings with real weather and notification data to write friendly care messages, urgency levels and watering predictions - all shown live on this dashboard.
